method: Official municipal and county websites, official visitor pages and official planning maps. Names only extracted; planning notes are conditional practical advice rather than source claims about properties.
boundaryCautions: McGregor spans Essex and Amherstburg; avoid implying entire community only in Essex.
Elmwood spans West Grey and Brockton.
Belgrave, Auburn and Whitechurch include portions in adjacent municipalities; North Huron official plan explicitly states portions.
Monkton is shared with West Perth; Sebringville spans Perth East and Perth South.
Wellandport is at the West Lincoln/Wainfleet boundary.
Grassie is adjacent to Grimsby; use address to resolve municipality.
Singhampton is near Grey Highlands/Clearview boundary; do not imply every address belongs to Grey Highlands.
Glendale also occurs in other regions; always retain Niagara-on-the-Lake qualifier.
Mapleton community in Central Elgin is different from Mapleton Township, Wellington County.
Durham community in West Grey is different from Durham Region.
Mount Pleasant, Union, York, Greenfield, Clyde, Princeton and Lakeside need municipality context in titles/slugs.
Hamilton names include nested former municipalities, villages and settlement areas; Flamborough and Glanbrook overlap smaller community labels and are not exclusive boundaries.
Cambridge Galt, Preston, Hespeler and Blair are inherited community names within Cambridge, not separate municipal governments.
Guelph/Eramosa community names are search geography, not claims of exclusive boundaries; Ariss and Eden Mills should be verified against the project address.
gaps: This is a researched initial list, not a complete gazetteer or every Ontario settlement.
Essex municipalities beyond Essex and Lakeshore need further community-level research.
Lambton municipalities beyond Lambton Shores need further community-level research.
Elgin municipalities beyond Central Elgin need further community-level research.
Perth South and West Perth need fuller lists.
Bruce County municipalities beyond Northern Bruce Peninsula and Saugeen Shores need fuller lists.
Grey County municipalities beyond Grey Highlands, West Grey and Meaford need fuller lists.
Wellington Puslinch still needs fuller community research.
Norfolk rural hamlets and additional Niagara hamlets remain.
